description: The Local Group census: every galaxy in the Updated Nearby Galaxy Catalog within 1.5 Mpc. Distances are primarily TRGB, Cepheid, horizontal-branch and colour-magnitude-diagram measurements, not redshift-derived.
sourceRowsNote: The full UNGC catalogue table served by VizieR holds 869 Local Volume galaxies with a distance (out to 26.2 Mpc); 81 of them fall inside 1.5 Mpc and are emitted here. The remainder belongs to the cosmic layer, not the galactic layer.

source.paper: Karachentsev I.D., Makarov D.I., Kaisina E.I. 2013, AJ, 145, 101
source.title: Updated Nearby Galaxy Catalog (UNGC)
source.version: VizieR catalogue J/AJ/145/101 (catalog: 869 rows, table6: 783 rows)
source.liveVersion: The catalogue is maintained live at http://www.sao.ru/lv/lvgdb/ ; the VizieR snapshot is the 2013 published version and is what is pinned here.

frame.cartesian: Heliocentric galactic Cartesian, kpc: +x toward the Galactic centre (l=0, b=0), +y toward l=90 deg, +z toward the North Galactic Pole. The Sun is the origin. NOTE: this differs from the galactocentric frame used by masers.json and field.bin — at Local Group distances the 8.15 kpc offset is negligible but the axes differ, so convert with X = y, Y = 8.15 - x, Z = z + 0.0055 (kpc) if you need the galactocentric frame.
frame.note: The "Milky Way" row is emitted with kind="host" and all Cartesian components zero.

units.distanceKpc: kpc (0 on the Milky Way row — we are inside it)
units.sunToGalacticCentreKpc: kpc, set only on the Milky Way row; see caveats

caveats: distancePrecision tells you which number you are looking at. "distance-modulus (adopted method)" means distanceKpc was recomputed from the UNGC table6 distance modulus measured with the method the catalogue adopts, which is far more precise than the main table's "Dist" column rounded to 0.01 Mpc (= 10 kpc, useless for Milky Way satellites).

UNGC is the 2013 published catalogue. Roughly 40 ultra-faint Milky Way satellites discovered since (DES, Pan-STARRS, HSC, Gaia) are NOT in it. This file is complete with respect to its source, not with respect to the sky.

The "Milky Way" row exists in UNGC with Dist = 0.01 Mpc, which is its Sun-Galactic-centre distance, not a distance to a galaxy. It is emitted with kind="host", distanceKpc = 0 and zeroed Cartesian coordinates so a renderer cannot place a galaxy 8 kpc from the Sun. The UNGC value is preserved in sunToGalacticCentreKpc (7.94 kpc from its "geom" distance modulus) — note this differs from the R0 = 8.15 kpc that masers.json, arms.json and field.bin use, which is Reid+2019. Prefer R0 = 8.15 kpc; the UNGC number is kept only so nothing is silently discarded.
host is assigned from the UNGC "main disturber" (MD) column, which is a tidal-influence assignment, not a dynamical membership proof.

galaxies.name: Milky Way
galaxies.distancePrecision: n/a — we are inside this galaxy
